in_marathi.name: Jeevikaa
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jeevikaa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jīvikā is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘jīva’ which means soul. The name Jeevikaa symbolizes the embodiment of life and the soul's journey. The name is often given to girls born into families who wish to bestow upon their child the blessings of a long and prosperous life.
